rv.q: This savage, hilarious, incredibly sad work- now transferred from the Royal Court to the West End- is the best new play of the year.
It's a vicious, funny play, stained with nicotine and nihilism.
Mr McDonagh's writing is sharp, the plotting clever, characterisation skilful and Anna Fleischle's set superb. Yet this is a play that is easier to admire than to love.
This is a darkly funny new play that has an off-the-scale hit rate in terms of wicked one-liners.
